_comment: The two distributions of this app. Everything the app DOES lives in
manifest.template.yml; this file only says which app it IS.
They are genuinely separate Forge apps with separate app ids, separate
installations and separate storage. Installing both on one site is fine and
expected during a cutover — they do not share config or audit log.
appId is the only field that cannot be invented: it comes from
`forge register`, which must be run by a human because it accepts Atlassian's
developer terms. Leave it empty until then; use-manifest.mjs refuses to build
a variant with no id rather than deploying over the wrong app.

marketplace.label: Marketplace
marketplace.notes: The app already live on the Dash Jira site, intended for public listing. licensingEnabled stays false until a licensing model is chosen — turning it on gates the app behind a licence check and is a behaviour change, not a label.

internal.label: Dash internal
internal.notes: Dash's own private copy. Never listed, never licensed. The distinct title is what lets an admin tell the two apart in the Jira Apps menu once both are installed.
